# OpenClaw Workspace Wrapper

<!-- Generated by ~/.agents/sync.sh -->

The canonical workflow source lives in `{{HUB}}`.

## Read Order
1. `{{HUB}}/AGENTS.md`
2. `./.agents/repo.md` if present
3. `./SOUL.md`
4. `./USER.md`
5. `./TOOLS.md`

## Purpose
This wrapper keeps OpenClaw aligned with the shared workflow hub while preserving local OpenClaw context in this workspace.

## OpenClaw Workflow Policy
- Raycast via the Docker localhost gateway is the primary interaction surface for this setup.
- For substantial coding work, follow shared hub RPI commands in order:
  - `research_codebase`
  - `create-plan`
  - `implement_plan`
  - `validate_plan`
  - `pr`
- Prefer shared hub commands over embedding long end-to-end workflows inside a single skill.
- Treat heartbeat as advisory only. Use cron for exact scheduled work.
